title: 5th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) include me with the seekers of Your forgiveness,

verses.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْهِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ الْقَانِتِيْنَ،
verses.translation: include me on it with Your righteous, submissive servants,
and include me on it with Your favorite, intimate servants,
in the name of Your kindness, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
